comparison.objective: Hold a spring-backed valve cartridge fully home while inserting its retainer clip, versus set and jam-lock a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1905 uses one hand to oppose axial O-ring force while the other aligns and slides a U-clip; the candidate opposes rotational locknut reaction with a driver while tightening with a wrench.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1905 requires flush cartridge seating, fully seated clip, and retention under a 20 N pull; the candidate requires angular accuracy, nut retention, and repeatable actuation.
comparison.reason: Both coordinate holding with locking, but axial part seating plus transverse clip insertion is a different tested mechanism and ability from countertorque-preserved screw adjustment.
